info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Channel Performance Insights API
info.description: The Channel Performance Insights API enables businesses to access detailed analysis of their channel portfolio. This endpoint provides comprehensive insights into channel performance metrics, helping stakeholders identify trends and make informed decisions. Typical consumers include business analysts and strategic planners who require data to optimize channel strategies. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their understanding of channel dynamics and drive growth.

get.summary: Retrieve channel portfolio analysis for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the channel portfolio analysis for the specified resource ID. It provides insights on the performance metrics, enabling better decision-making and strategy adjustments based on data-driven results.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve specific business analysis information for the channel portfolio related to the resource identified by RES-100045. It expects a properly formatted JSON object that aligns with the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested channel portfolio data.
